literal: And desire and modesty, life not protecting, hang inside my unable to bear body.
translation: Within my body, which is unable to bear the pain, desire and modesty hang like a balanced load, leaving my life unprotected.
modern: தாங்க முடியாத என் உடம்பினுள்ளே, உயிரைக் காக்காமல், காமமும் நாணமும் இரு பக்கமும் தொங்கிக் கொண்டிருக்கின்றன.
explanation: The heroine describes her intense internal conflict using the metaphor of a shoulder-pole (kāvadi). Her desire (kāmam) pulls her toward her lover, while her modesty (nāṇam) holds her back. These two opposing forces hang like heavy weights on either side of her fragile body, which is unable to bear the strain. As a result of this constant tug-of-war, her life remains unprotected and hangs precariously in the balance.
